findRoute.q: How do I find a route?
findRoute.a: On the home screen, tap "Starting point" and search for the address (or use your current location). Then tap "Destination", search for the address and pick one of the results. Finally, tap "Find route".

startTrip.q: How do I start a trip?
startTrip.a: In the routes found, tap "View route" to see the line's stops and then "Start trip". The app uses your device's GPS to follow the trip.

followTrip.q: How do I follow the trip?
followTrip.a: During the trip, the screen shows the next stop, how many stops are left and the distance to the destination. Near the destination you get a voice and vibration alert, according to your settings.

accessibility.q: How do I set up accessibility?
accessibility.a: In Settings you adjust text size, high contrast, dark mode, voice, speech speed and vibration. Use "Test feedback" to check your choice.

simpleMode.a: It is a version with fewer elements on screen: you choose the destination among your favorite places, with large buttons. Turn it on in Settings and off whenever you like.

privacyPolicy.q: Privacy Policy and Terms of Use
privacyPolicy.a: We collect your name and email to create your account, and your location (with your permission) only to suggest your trip's starting point and track your journey in real time — it is never sent to third parties or stored beyond what that function needs. Addresses you search are looked up through a geocoding service (OpenStreetMap/Nominatim), without linking the search to your name. Your password is never stored or visible to us: we only keep a secure hash (Argon2id). Favorites and search history are saved only on your device. You can edit or delete your profile data anytime in "Edit profile" and sign out in Settings.

screenReader.q: How do I use a screen reader on Android?
screenReader.a: Android includes TalkBack, a screen reader that reads items on the screen and helps with navigation. To turn it on or off, open Android Settings, go to Accessibility, and look for TalkBack. Option names may vary by Android version. With TalkBack on, swipe with one finger to move between items and double-tap to activate the focused item.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: On the home screen, tap "Starting point", type the address and tap Search. Pick a result from the list. You can also tap "Use my current location" to fill it in with GPS.

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: Tap "Destination", type the street name, number and neighborhood, and tap Search. Pick the right address among the results. Then tap "Find route".

routes.title: Routes and trip
routes.description: "Routes found" lists the bus lines, from fastest to slowest. Tap "View route" to see the stops and "Start trip" to be warned when you are arriving.

favorites.title: Favorites
favorites.description: In the Favorites tab, tap "Add place" to save an address with a nickname, like Home or Work. On the home screen, tap a favorite to fill in the origin or destination.

history.title: History
history.description: The History tab keeps your last 10 searches. Tap any of them to repeat that search.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: In Settings you make text larger, turn on high contrast or dark mode, choose voice, vibration or both, and use "Test feedback" to check.

simpleMode.title: Simple Mode
simpleMode.description: If you prefer less information on screen, turn on Simple Mode in Settings. You choose the destination with large buttons, from your favorite places.
